name: ARMOR-NETWORK
role: Local network monitor: the devices on the house's network, the internet's state and what changes
deployment_target: Any machine on the network being watched (a PC, the CM5, a Raspberry Pi); it reports to ARMOR-SERVER
notes: The scanner, the inventory and its events, the internet state machine and the message are tested on a computer against a scripted network: 93 tests, all passing, and every message is accepted by ARMOR-COMMON. The program runs as a service on the CM5 test bench, watching the real network the bench is on. It only observes: it sends echoes, TCP connections to a few ports and the multicast questions of mDNS and SSDP to the private network it is on, and a few questions to public addresses to know whether the internet is there. It never configures a router or a device and does not capture packets.
